notes.title: 🔧 Patch Notes – AI Behavior Balancing Update
notes.notes:
We've just released a new patch focused on improving and balancing the AI behavior for a more immersive and fair experience. Here's what's changed:

AI Improvements & Balance Changes:
Improved AI Hearing Range:
The AI can now detect sounds from a slightly larger distance, making stealth more important.

Adjusted Footstep Detection:

Running steps are now quieter, reducing the chance of being detected when sprinting short distances.

Dropped items also produce less noise, allowing for more strategic interactions and baiting.

These changes aim to balance challenge and player freedom while maintaining tension in each encounter. We’ll continue tweaking AI behavior based on your feedback — keep it coming!

Thank you for playing and supporting the game!

notes.title: Nightfall Secrets - Hotfix
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

We've just released a small hotfix based on your feedback. The enemy spawn location has been adjusted to give players more time to prepare at the start of each match. This change should provide a fairer and more balanced experience, especially in the early moments of gameplay.

notes.title: Nightfall Secrets - Hotfix
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

We've made a few improvements based on player feedback:

Added key binding support for item slots
You can now customize your controls for faster and more comfortable item switching.

Adjusted AI difficulty
The previous "Medium" difficulty has been reclassified as "Nightmare" and toned down slightly to make gameplay more balanced and accessible.

notes.title: 🎉 Game Release Announcement 🎉
notes.notes:
🕯️ Nightfall Secrets is Out Now! 🕯️ Lonely Horror Studio is proud to announce the official release of Nightfall Secrets, a chilling 4v1 co-op horror experience filled with tension, mystery, and supernatural terror!

💀 About the Game Nightfall Secrets is an asymmetrical horror game where up to 4 players must work together to complete randomized objectives and escape—while being hunted by a powerful AI-controlled entity. Every noise you make could be your last, as the enemy can hear footsteps, dropped objects, and even your voice.

🔦 Key Features:

🎮 4v1 Co-op Horror – Team up with friends to survive against a deadly AI.

🎯 Randomized Objectives – Each match brings new tasks and new challenges.

👣 Sound-Reactive AI – Stay quiet, or risk being found. The AI listens and learns.

👻 Multiple AI Types – Face different enemy behaviors with unique abilities.

🏚️ Haunting Environments – Explore dark, atmospheric locations hiding terrible secrets.
